notes.title: Halloween Update! 1.19.6
notes.content:
[b]1.19 Changes on MITS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gun Animations!
[*] Halloween decors over the map
[*] New site, Graveyard!
[*] New boss entrance!
[*] Mini-boss, the Grim Reaper!
[*] New Weapons! (Mini-gun, lawn mower, sythe)
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Shop changes! (Currency balance, able to purchase weapons at shop)
[*] Mobs drop unique coins for each mob
[*] 2 New Achivements!
[*] Fixed new player bug (Unable to spawn the spawners unless tutorial played)
[/list]

notes.title: Better Map, Better Save and More Achivements!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Round Map
[*] Compass On Map
[*] Win a game to unlock next difficulty
[*] More Achievements
[*] Small Bug Fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Better Bits Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Settings UI changes
[*] Save system changes/improvements
[*] Fov slider
[*] Camera position changed to center of player
[*] Completely removed the possibility of shots shooting self
[*] All game qualities have torch visability
[*] Button fixes
[*] Tutorial mobs not pushable
[*] Achievements system improved and more efficient
[*] Cover screens fill whole screen
[/list]

notes.title: Achivements and Small Changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Achievements
[*] Added social links
[*] Ray gun glitch fixed
[*] Smaller details fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplatform Support & Boss Upgrade
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Game playable on Windows and Mac!
[*] Boss model change, and with animations
[*] Fix building placements
[*] Fix Ligting
[*] Take damage when on rocks
[*] Stop mobs spawning ontop of rock alters
[*] Boss bar fix
[*] Ray gun spins
[*] Better Loading screen
[*] Spelling fixes
[*] Skeleton animation speed reduced & health reduced
[*] Shop text activates when in close distance
[*] Ray gun aim improved
[*] Tutorial scene change
[*] Add the 3 pickups to tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Shops, Tutorial & Practice
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tutorial, helps new players understand the process of the game!
[*] Practice, play in a arena to improve your skills with access to all weapons!
[*] Shops, now able to purchase; ammo, health & armour/shield to help prepare for the boss fight!
[/list]

notes.title: Scene Loading and Lighting
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rocket Launcher does damage to boss targets
[*] Lighting global Illuminations rendered
[*] Better Mini-map
[*] Loading into boss scene wont have glitching at start
[/list]

notes.title: Rocket, Jumping & Navigation Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed and increased jumping height
[*] Navigation of mobs in city map improved
[*] Rocket launcher nerfed, has set damage (Use to instant kill everything)
[*] Hit directly with Rocket Launcher will increase damage
[*] Camera cutting against walls removed (Cant see through walls when against it)
[/list]

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Invisable walls
[*] Mob walkthough some walls
[*] Scene object hitboxed fixed
[/list]

notes.title: UI and Game Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - On hurt hit sound and blood visual UI
[*] - Stop Shooting in pause 
[*] - Running fixed
[*] - More gun and summoner locations 
[*] - Extend range of viewing range on mobs per difficulty 
[*] - Boss fight has more fog 
[/list]

notes.title: Run away from the NEW Animations!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some IU changes
[*] Running ability
[*] New animations for general mobs
[*] Bazooka nerfed
[*] Loading screen into boss fight
[*] Fastest time fixed
[*] Boss hitbox fixed
[*] Pickups have de-spawn times (Easy = 2 min, Normal = 30 secs, Hard = 15secs, Impossible = 5secs)
[/list]
